title: benmaster82/writher
summary: 🎙️ Offline voice productivity for Windows - dictate text into any app and control a local AI assistant by voice. Manages notes, to-do lists, appointments & reminders. 100% local: faster-whisper + Ollama + SQLite. No cloud, no telemetry. Free and open source alternative to Wispr Flow

title: iota31/meeting-intelligence
summary: Meeting transcript intelligence: decisions and action items with deterministic speaker and timestamp citations, plus grounded Q&A that refuses when the transcript does not support an answer.

title: Glad-Labs/poindexter
summary: The open-source AI content factory that runs on your PC — discovers topics, researches, writes, reviews with multi-model QA, and publishes. Local-first via Ollama, $0 API costs.

title: pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai
summary: The open-source context layer for AI agents. PipesHub turns your company's knowledge (Slack, Drive, Jira, GitHub, Microsoft 365 and 40+ connectors) into a permission-aware workspace that agents can search, grep, navigate and cite. MCP, SDKs and built-in agents. Self-hosted.

title: bcyr/bc250-monitor
summary: Lightweight thermal & performance dashboard for the AMD BC-250, with a thermal guard for local LLMs (Ollama). Zero dependencies.

title: metadist/synaplan
summary: Open-source, self-hosted AI platform (PHP/Symfony): chat with any model, RAG over your docs, embeddable widget, MCP — see the cost of every answer. Apache-2.0.

title: furaxdev/Runyx
summary: Open language models, running on your own computer. Open source, no account, no telemetry.

title: FynnXland/fleech
summary: Local voice dictation for Windows & Linux: hold a key, speak, and clean text appears wherever your cursor is. Whisper speech-to-text plus AI cleanup via a local Ollama model, or your own OpenAI/Claude/Gemini key. No account, no audio leaves your PC. German & English. Free and open source (MIT).

title: negativexq/knowledge-base-rag
summary: Agentic document research with PydanticAI: typed workflows, scoped tools, cited answers, chart and table extraction, checked calculations, and budgeted execution.

title: LocketKeyLLC/scaffold-engine
summary: Self-hosted AI agent engine for local LLMs. Give it an idea — it researches the web, plans a DAG of steps, executes each with verification and auto-retry, and compiles the result. 100% on your hardware: Ollama inference, RAG with Milvus vector search, Postgres state, SearXNG search. FastAPI + Docker. No cloud calls unless you opt in.

title: Iman-Alnahwi/Xplore
summary: Open-source AI tutor & file-action agent: explains code line by line for beginners (Arabic/English/Turkish) and turns screenshots into actions. Runs Gemma 4 locally via Ollama.

title: nodetool-ai/nodetool
summary: Agent-first Creative Workspace

title: the-vibey-project/vibey
summary: Open-source orchestrator for AI coding agents: a spec interview, unattended builds on local (Ollama) or paid agents, human-gated review, and an append-only PostgreSQL ledger so a crashed agent's work is picked up, not lost.

title: roloVibes/Halo-Harness
summary: Multi-model agent harness with orchestration, Claude Code compatibility, local LLM support, and live agent monitoring.

title: shimo4228/contemplative-agent
summary: A long-running experiment: an AI agent posts on its own with a local LLM (Ollama, one 16 GB Mac) and proposes changes to its harness (the constitution, identity and skills in its prompts), never its weights. A person keeps the final word on each proposal, and the adopted history is public.

title: EdoardoDevelop/easyisland
summary: Isola animata per Windows per agenti coding (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI) e chat AI (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama): permessi, azioni rapide, automazioni e integrazioni (3CX, Outlook, GitHub).

title: Conker-AI/pi
summary: Conker's runtime: conversations, model routing, tool calls and an append-only record of every turn.

title: ogneocortext/space-analyzer-pro
summary: Space Analyzer Pro — cross-platform disk-space analyzer with a Rust core, native WinUI 3 GUI, and a local Ollama-powered AI assistant for agentic cleanup.

title: RalfHermsen/x4-agent
summary: A local-LLM agent that plays X4: Foundations according to your own guidelines. The model plans, deterministic Python computes and executes. Built on SirNukes' Mod Support APIs.

title: dawith-ai/dawith-welfare-office
summary: Dawith local-first welfare record workspace with privacy-preserving demo and Windows app
